messages:
morgan: Quick heads up — PR #27134 ready but hit flaky mac_e2e in CI. Can we gate merge until we get a rebase window? Prefer to avoid shipping during Thu maintenance. 
ash: Thanks for flagging. Holding LGTM pending CI. 
sam: Can you paste the failing snippet? wondering if it's the timeout we've seen. 
morgan: sure — here's the failing part from the job logs:
```
FAIL tests/e2e/test_file_sync.py::TestFileSync::test_large_file_sync - TimeoutError: waited 300s
...
```
morgan: Looks like a hang in the file transfer step. Not a unit regressor but flakes under certain mac runners. 
ci-bot: build #9876 (PR 27134) — mac_e2e failed after 00:05:12 (timeout). Retries exhausted.
juan: we can try a targeted rerun of just mac_e2e on a different pool. I can kick that off unless we want to hold. 
kelly: reminder — infra maintenance Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC. Recommend holding until after the window to avoid noisy rollouts. 
release-coordinator: If we delay, what's the earliest safe merge slot? Tue rebase window at 14:00 UTC works, or Mon afternoon if folks available. 
morgan: Tue 14:00 UTC sounds good. I'll add `hold/awaiting-rebase` label and request a rebase slot. 
ash: added label `hold/awaiting-rebase` :white_check_mark: 
sam: Juan — can you try the targeted rerun now and post results? if it's green we can re-evaluate. 
juan: starting rerun on alternate mac pool now. ETA ~10m. I'll post logs here. 
juan: rerun finished — mac_e2e passed on alternate pool. Uploading artifact link: https://ci.example.com/build/9876/artifacts 
ash: nice. Given the pass, I'm okay with keeping the hold to avoid coupling with Thu maintenance. 
morgan: agreed. Keeping hold label until Tue rebase slot. Thanks all :pray:
